errors.evidence: The chart clearly shows seven distinct slices, not six.

The description incorrectly assigns percentages to the categories. The correct values are: “Speech” (29.4%), “Mix-Sound-Speech” (21.8%), “Music” (20.6%), “Sound” (16.5%), “Mix-Music-Speech” (8.2%), “Mix-Sound-Music-Speech” (2.4%), and “Mix-Sound-Music” (1.1%). The description swaps several values and omits the 'Mix-Sound-Music' category.

errors.text_span: The slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest in size.
errors.evidence: The slices are not arranged in order of size. For example, going clockwise from the top, the percentages are 1.1%, 29.4%, 21.8%, 20.6%, 16.5%, 8.2%, and 2.4%, which is not a descending or ascending order.
